summary: RCCB multilingual site (/site/rccb) tested end-to-end on preview URL. All 13 feature areas from the review request pass on desktop and mobile. Home hero renders with the exact English headline 'Impeccable spaces, every single day.', 3 videos + 3 dots cycling, CTA buttons present and functional. Header turns solid white on scroll (bg-white class applied when scrollY>40). Language switcher works correctly: NL -> nav 'Home/Diensten/Galerij/Contact', hero 'Onberispelijke ruimtes, elke dag opnieuw.'; FR -> 'Accueil/Services/Galerie/Contact', hero 'Des espaces impeccables, jour apres jour.'; EN back to default. Stats (4), service teaser (6), why points (4), final CTA all render on home. Services page shows 12 cards (6 B2B + 6 Specialist filters verified). Gallery shows 18 photos initially, load-more reveals 36, lightbox opens on photo click. Contact form renders all fields and POST /api/public/contact returns 200 with {success:true}, success UI 'Thank you! We'll get back to you within 24h.' is shown. Footer contains Excelsiorlaan 36-38 1930 Zaventem address, VAT BE 0793.291.833, webmaster link -> https://www.fworksbuilders.com. Floating WhatsApp button present with href https://wa.me/32472700402. Mobile hamburger opens side menu with nav + language buttons.

issues: Escape key does not close the lightbox (only backdrop click / X button). Consider adding window keydown Escape handler for better UX and testability.

Filter bar is sticky with 'top-[72px]'. When browser is at y=0 the transparent header is 'py-4' (~88px tall) so the filter bar visually overlaps the header area on initial scroll. Minor; not blocking.

action_items: Optional: add window Escape key handler in GalleryPage to close the lightbox (improves UX and makes automated UI tests more deterministic).

Optional: the console showed a 404 on one request ('Failed to load resource 404' + 'Error loading site: AxiosError') during home load — appears to come from a site-config/analytics fetch but did not affect rendering. Investigate and silence if it is a stale endpoint.
Optional: sticky services filter bar top offset (72px) could be aligned with the actual header heights in scrolled vs unscrolled states.
critical_code_review_comments: RccbApp.js is 941 lines in a single file — consider splitting Navigation, Footer, HomePage, ServicesPage, GalleryPage, ContactPage into separate files for maintainability (limit <700 lines/file).

nav-link data-testid uses label.toLowerCase() which changes per language (nav-link-home/nav-link-diensten/nav-link-accueil). This is brittle for automated tests — prefer stable keys (nav-link-home/services/gallery/contact) mapped from the link key, independent of language.
Analytics fetch in PageTracker swallows all errors with .catch(() => {}) — OK for prod but hides genuine misconfigurations during dev.
hero-video-{i} data-testid prefix overlaps hero-video-dot-{i} when using selector '[data-testid^=hero-video-]' — tests selecting all videos must subtract dots or use a distinct prefix.
ContactPage form state uses a single 'error' status with no field-level validation feedback beyond HTML5 required.
seed_data_creation: Submitted one TEST contact form entry via /api/public/contact (name='TEST Automation', email='test_auto@example.com').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://image-restore-21.preview.emergentagent.com. RCCB routes at /site/rccb, /site/rccb/services, /site/rccb/gallery, /site/rccb/contact. All data-testids used are defined in /app/frontend/src/sites/rccb/RccbApp.js and VideoHero.js. Use page.wait_for_selector (not networkidle) because the hero video keeps the network active. Default language is auto-detected from navigator.language; Playwright defaults to en-US so pages render in English by default. When testing the lightbox, close it via backdrop click (position 10,10) or the X button — Escape keypress does NOT close it.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - fresh build, all critical flows pass.
